data.title: Rejection of tree felling permit application (Ablehnung Fällgenehmigung)
data.case_title: Bezirksamt Musterbek – Rejection of felling permit for beech tree
data.summary: Bezirksamt Musterbek (Fachamt Management des öffentlichen Raumes) rejected Sophie Mustermann's application of 16.03.2026 to fell a protected common beech tree (Rotbuche) at Eppendorfer Stieg 7, citing the Tree Protection Ordinance (Baumschutzverordnung). An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office (Bezirksamt) has refused permission to cut down a protected beech tree on your property, ruling that the balcony shading you cited does not justify felling it under the Baumschutzverordnung (tree protection ordinance). If you disagree, you can file a written, electronic, or in-person objection (Widerspruch) with the Bezirksamt by the deadline shown in this record. If you do nothing, the rejection stands and the tree may not be felled. Consider consulting a lawyer specializing in administrative or environmental law if you wish to contest this.

key_facts.label: Reason for rejection
key_facts.value: Tree is protected under the Baumschutzverordnung, vital and stable; the claimed balcony shading is not an unreasonable impairment
key_facts.quote: Der Baum ist nach der Baumschutzverordnung geschützt. Er ist vital und standsicher; die geltend gemachte Verschattung Ihres Balkons stellt keine unzumutbare Beeinträchtigung dar.
